item.title: President Ilham Aliyev shares post on March 8 - International Women's Day
item.description: President of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev shared a post on his social media accounts on the occasion of March 8 – International Women's Day.

item.title: Fire breaks out at gas station in Russia, suspect detained
item.description: A fire broke out at a gas station in St. Petersburg, Russia, AzerNEWS reports, citing Russian media.

item.title: Juventus eyes Brentford defender Michael Kayode in summer transfer
item.description: Michael Kayode, the 21-year-old right-back currently playing for Brentford, could be on his way back to Italy, AzerNEWS reports, citing international media.

item.title: First VP Mehriban Aliyeva congratulates Azerbaijani women on International Women’s Day
item.description: First Vice-President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Mehriban Aliyeva shared a post on her social media accounts on the occasion of March 8 – International Women's Day.

item.title: Tehran says American troops taken prisoner, US military denies
item.description: Senior Iranian official Ali Larijani has claimed that Iranian forces captured several American soldiers, accusing Washington of attempting to hide the incident.

item.title: Israel warns Lebanon of “full price” if Hezbollah attacks continue
item.description: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz warned Lebanon on Saturday that the country would face the “full price” if attacks by Hezbollah persist.

item.title: Iran–US–Israel war: possible scenarios
item.description: The war between Iran and the U.S.–Israel alliance is troubling the entire world. This conflict is critical for the global economy and could trigger tectonic shifts both in the region and globally. Yet developments on the ground raise many questions. The U.S. and Israel claim they seek regime change, bombing Iran and assassinating key officials. item.title: Turkish President Erdoğan holds phone call with UK PM Starmer
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan held a phone conversation with UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer, AzerNEWS reports, citing Turkish media.

item.title: Top US analysts say Iran’s leadership could survive major war
item.description: A classified assessment by the National Intelligence Council (NIC) indicates that even a major US military campaign would likely fail to dismantle Iran’s ruling military and clerical establishment.

item.title: Baku praises Washington for condemning Iran drone strikes
item.description: Azerbaijan has welcomed the statement by the United States Department of State condemning drone attacks carried out by Iran against Azerbaijani territory and expressing solidarity with the country.
